claims.claim: Makes the as-of date visible for every changeable roster, status, version, or measurement.
claims.notes: The dated series demonstrates why a TVL value needs an as-of date.

sources.quote: Get historical TVL ... of a chain; Get current TVL of all chains.

sources.quote: This repo is for TVL adapters ... TVL must be computed from blockchain data.
/v2/historicalChainTvl/{chain} excludes liquid staking and double counted tvl.

claims.notes: The official API description and source repository state the endpoint scope and computation basis.
The intraday value differs from the completed daily point, so retrieval time is material.

claims.claim: Separates chain TVL from protocol, RWA, and asset measures.

sources.quote: The API lists separate chain TVL, protocol TVL, stablecoin market-cap, RWA, DEX-volume, and pool-yield endpoints.

claims.notes: The provider exposes these measures through distinct endpoint families.
